content.study:
Section 24 — Hearings and written proceedings

The tribunal determines whether to hold oral hearings or proceed on documents, subject to the statutory right to an oral hearing when properly requested unless the parties have agreed that no oral hearing will be held. Parties must receive sufficient advance notice, and material supplied to the tribunal by one party must be communicated to the other.

Apply the provision by identifying its operative conditions, procedural stage, connected statutory provisions and precise consequence.
